prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit this own inspected poster into ONE flat opaque landscape 16:9 final poster. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

One local correction on the printing action: the current lifted rubber block has a pale branch cut into a dark face, whereas its paper impression is a dark positive branch. Correct the ink-transfer relationship while retaining the current block thickness, smooth matte violet-grey rubber side walls, tilt, location, lifting gap and grasping fingers.
The visible carving face of the block must have DARK INDIGO INK ON RAISED BRANCH, LEAF AND BERRY SHAPES, surrounded by visibly recessed PALE GREY-VIOLET RUBBER. It should read as an actual rubber relief ready to transfer a positive dark branch onto the pale sheet. No dark rectangular background surrounding a white branch. Keep narrow pale cut lines within the raised leaves where the same pale cuts appear in the paper impression.
Use the existing dark positive botanical impression at the right of the title as the precise design to reproduce on this rubber relief face, with the same main stem forks, each leaf placement and each round berry. Mirror the rubber relief design as needed so transfer would create that same paper impression. Perspective may differ; the actual branch structure must correspond. Preserve the existing paper impression's location and scale, and make changes only if needed to achieve this single rubber-to-paper correspondence. Keep it nonletter; do not add any invented words.

Protect the entire rest of the poster: every one of its ELEVEN copy entries stays verbatim and exactly once, with the current line arrangement, word spaces, numerals and punctuation. Preserve the long time-range dash, the two-line central Korean serif title on the same shared page, and all crisp Hangul counters and stroke proportions. Keep the upper-left date/time/venue/entry group, upper-right English/activity, bottom-left fee/application and bottom-right preparation/welcome, with readable type at 720px width.
Keep TWO adult readers, their eyes and open reading mouth and inward gaze at this same title-bearing sheet, the continuing third printing forearm entering from lower left, the fingers gripping the block's side, the burnt-orange oblique ellipse and the pale lilac outside ground. Preserve engraved indigo people, current face crops and body scale, page outline, all fact ledges, background and table finish. The paper carries both title and real transferred nonletter output; no separate book or page.
Change only the relief face and minimum corresponding print features required for coherent physical transfer. No new text, logo, QR, watermark, microtype, loose hands, extra objects, extra people, panels, contact sheet or room mockup.
